note: Survey sites for benchmarks/gap_survey.py. Public, well-known water bodies chosen for geographic spread. They are points, not polygons, and stand in for the pilot manifest until examples/water-bodies-public-pilot.geojson exists. Customer water bodies never enter this repository (assumption A8). Group us is the service area (assumption A4). Group context tests whether a gap is regional or global.
